description: E22ASB106 is the drawing identifier for emergency-stop station component in AutomationDirect's 22mm Non-metal collection. An emergency-stop station component provides part of a machine stopping interface. Its mechanical placement does not establish the safety performance of the complete stopping circuit.

For example, in a machine installation with a clearly accessible stop station, use the E22ASB106 reference to coordinate operator approach, operating head and rear contact wiring. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Pushbuttons Switches Indicators/22mm Non-metal/Eaton Cutler-Hammer E22 Series/E22ASB106.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
